text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: answers: a run that does not finish counts as its time limit (300 or 600 s), a time under 0.2 s as 0.2 s. Beside

text.style: fill: #59636e; font: 10.5px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
